items.problem: The scaffold, bootstrap, and self-check were launched concurrently, producing Target not found and false self-check results.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 12-31 shows all three calls issued together; the scaffold completed only after bootstrap and self-check had already failed.
items.covered_at: SKILL.md Step 0 - Bootstrap (mandatory), especially the numbered first-three-command block and Target description.
items.proposed_improvement: Call the commands a dependency chain and explicitly forbid batching/parallelization; require successful exit before the next command.
items.generalizes: Scaffolding must finish before any migration bootstrap can resolve the target in every scenario.
